Class MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder
Enclosing class:
MetroOptimizer
public static final class MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for defining a workload specification. Each workload carries a WorkloadType with built-in infrastructure defaults that can be individually overridden. Workloads can also declare provider dependencies to ensure they are placed in metros where those providers are available.

Profile resolution order: explicit profile(WorkloadProfile) overrides take precedence, then individual method overrides (e.g., maxLatencyToleranceMs(double)), then the WorkloadType's built-in defaults.

    • latencySensitivity

      public MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder latencySensitivity(LatencySensitivity sensitivity)
      Overrides the latency sensitivity tier for this workload, independent of the WorkloadType's default. The tier's thresholdMs acts as the workload's default latency ceiling during placement whenever no explicit maxLatencyToleranceMs(double) is set — so CRITICAL/HIGH workloads are placed under a tighter default ceiling than LOW ones — and CRITICAL additionally routes the workload through lowest-latency placement.
      Parameters:
      sensitivity - the latency sensitivity tier
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • LatencySensitivity

    • bandwidthMbps

      public MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder bandwidthMbps(int bandwidth)

      Parameters:

      this builder for method chaining

    • maxLatencyToleranceMs

      public MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder maxLatencyToleranceMs(double maxMs)
      Sets an explicit maximum latency tolerance in milliseconds for this workload, overriding the default ceiling derived from the latency sensitivity tier's thresholdMs. The ceiling narrows which recommended metros this workload may be placed in (worst-case estimated latency to any user site); a ceiling no recommended metro can honour is stated on the placement and raised as a risk finding.
      Parameters:
      maxMs - the maximum acceptable latency in milliseconds
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • requiresHighPowerDensity

      public MetroOptimizer.WorkloadBuilder requiresHighPowerDensity()
      Records that this workload requires high power density infrastructure (e.g., for GPU-intensive AI/ML training). This is captured on the workload profile and carried through to the result for downstream facility selection; it is not currently a metro-scoring input, because the Fabric API does not expose per-metro power-density capability. Use it to document the requirement and to drive cabinet/cage sizing once a metro is chosen.
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • requiresLiquidCooling

Use it to document the requirement and to drive cabinet/cage selection once a metro is chosen.
      Returns:
